scores.name: Justin Tyme
scores.reason: The bottle he placed is identified as cyanide-bearing original, contradicting copy assumption; also touched target glass. Innocent mistaken identity remains possible.

assessment.why: Justin connects identified original to recovery site and handled target glass. Yet no evidence selects who contaminated miniature or broke original, and Al has corroborated glass contact plus a favor. These are strong leads, not yet a fair unique accusation.

plausibility_notes: Most plausible delivery is cyanide transferred from original into miniature, then a small dose into empty donor glass before punch. Clear photographs do not exclude residue. Common favor label and outside plaster/fibers do not identify poisoner.
